# Travel Agent Skills

> Agent skills for live flight and hotel pricing with Google's low|typical|high verdict

## Product

FlightPowers Travel Agent Skills — eight prompt-driven workflows for Claude, Cursor, and any agent runtime that reads a skills directory. Built on two independent real-time APIs: Google Flights Live API and Booking Live API, both available on RapidAPI.

Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Google or Booking.com.

## What it does

Gives your agent the data and the workflow to answer real travel questions:

- **Cheapest dates**: "When should I fly Berlin to Paris in September?" → one call searches five dates, ranked by price, each with Google's `low | typical | high` verdict
- **Destination compare**: "Somewhere warm under $400 in October from JFK" → fan out to multiple cities in one search
- **Trip planner**: "7 nights in Lisbon under $2000 for two, hotel needs free cancellation" → aligned flights + hotels, totalled per person
- **Fare watch**: Track one route over time, alert only on a meaningful drop
- **Hotel search**: Real-time Booking.com availability with 24 filters
- **Rate parity monitor**: Price the same hotel as a resident of several countries would see it

Every fare carries `price_insights_low`, `price_insights_high`, and `price_range_in_relation_to_other_periods` — Google's own historical band for that route and period. That is the difference between an agent that says "$49" and one that says "$49 is low for this route — book it, don't wait."

## Install (60 seconds)

### Free server (no key needed)

```bash
claude mcp add --transport http flightpowers https://google-flights-lulu.flightpowers.com/mcp
```

Four tools (one-way flights, round-trip, hotel search, hotel by name) load instantly. The free server is ad-supported: one disclosed sponsored card per response.

### Ad-free servers (your own RapidAPI key)

```bash
# Get a key at https://rapidapi.com/mtnrabi/api/google-flights-live-api
# Same key for hotels at https://rapidapi.com/mtnrabi/api/booking-live-api

claude mcp add --transport http flights https://flights.flightpowers.com/mcp \
  --header "x-rapidapi-key: YOUR_RAPIDAPI_KEY"

claude mcp add --transport http hotels https://hotels.flightpowers.com/mcp \
  --header "x-rapidapi-key: YOUR_RAPIDAPI_KEY"
```

### Skills (prompt workflows)

```bash
# Claude Code plugin
claude plugin marketplace add mtnrabi/travel-agent-skills
claude plugin install travel-agent-skills@travel-agent-skills

# Or any agent with a skills directory
git clone https://github.com/mtnrabi/travel-agent-skills.git
cp -r travel-agent-skills/skills/* ~/.claude/skills/
```

## APIs and MCPs

| Product | What | Where |
|---|---|---|
| Google Flights Live API | Real-time airfares with Google's price insights | https://rapidapi.com/mtnrabi/api/google-flights-live-api |
| Booking Live API | Real-time hotel availability and nightly rates | https://rapidapi.com/mtnrabi/api/booking-live-api |
| Flights MCP (ad-free) | Hosted MCP server, billed to your RapidAPI key | https://flights.flightpowers.com/mcp |
| Hotels MCP (ad-free) | Hosted MCP server, billed to your RapidAPI key | https://hotels.flightpowers.com/mcp |
| Free MCP (ad-supported) | Flights + hotels, no key needed, one disclosed ad per response | https://google-flights-lulu.flightpowers.com/mcp |

## Design rules

1. Prefer MCP tools when available; fall back to REST otherwise
2. Say what a call costs before making it — every billed request is the user's money
3. Check `X-Search-Status` (REST) or the tool's outcome note (MCP) before reporting a route as empty
4. Never cache or reuse a fare from earlier in the conversation — always fetch fresh
5. Lead with the answer, then the evidence
6. Never print, log, or commit an API key
7. No invented numbers — there are no uptime, latency, user-count or revenue claims anywhere in this repo
